core.title: 4-1/8 Inch Projection Coat and Hat Hook, Hamilton CH-103
tags: hamilton CH-103 coat and hat hooks

text.description_html:
Hamilton CH-103 Coat Hook

With a 4-1/8 inch projection, this Hamilton hook is perfect for holding thick winter coats and hats; but this wardrobe hook is versatile in that it will be just as useful mounted in closets, in bathroom door for towels, in the kitchen for cooking utensils--just about anywhere. However, what is great about this hook is that it will look alluring no matter where you surface mount it. It has a lifetime warranty and is available in either solid bronze with a bronze patina finish or in solid brass with a brushed nickel finish.

Features of the Hamilton CH-103 Utility Hook:

  • Hooks with a bronze patina finish are made out of solid bronze while hooks with a brushed nickel finish are made out of solid brass.
  • Package includes 3 Slotted oval head wood screws
  • Limited Lifetime Warranty

Specifications of the Hamilton Decorative Hook:

  • Overall Projection: 4-1/8"
  • Mount Height: 1-7/8"
  • Mount Width: 1-3/8"
